penaltyRoulette.title: Penalty Roulette
penaltyRoulette.description: Spin the wheel! Whoever it lands on must perform the dare

whatIs.title: What is Penalty Roulette?
whatIs.description: A fun tool for fairly deciding dares at company dinners, trips, couples activities, or any gathering. Choose from category presets or add your own custom items.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select a category that matches your situation (Company Dinner / Trip / Couple / Light).
Use the 'Custom' tab to add your own dares.
Click 'Spin!' to start the roulette wheel.
The selected dare is displayed with a dramatic animation.

tips.title: Tips
items: In Custom mode, add player names or situation-specific dares freely.
Check the history panel to see previously selected dares.
At least 2 items are required to spin.
